title: Filter a Precipitate
learningGoal: Collect a precipitate by gravity filtration: weigh and fold the paper, pour without overflowing, and rinse every grain onto the paper.

nodes.title: Set up the stand
nodes.description: Stand the ring stand on the bench, its iron ring over the base.

feedback.success: Set up the stand complete.
feedback.retry: Review Set up the stand and try again.

nodes.title: Seat the funnel
nodes.description: Rest the glass funnel in the iron ring.

feedback.success: Seat the funnel complete.
feedback.retry: Review Seat the funnel and try again.

nodes.title: Zero the balance
nodes.description: With the pan empty and the draft-shield doors closed, check that the balance reads 0.000 g, and press TARE if it does not.

feedback.success: Zero the balance complete.
feedback.retry: Review Zero the balance and try again.

nodes.title: Put the paper on the balance
nodes.description: Lay a dry filter paper flat on the balance pan.

feedback.success: Put the paper on the balance complete.
feedback.retry: Review Put the paper on the balance and try again.

nodes.title: Read the paper's mass
nodes.description: Read the balance and enter the dry paper's mass.

validation.label: Read the paper's mass was recorded.

feedback.success: Read the paper's mass complete.
feedback.retry: Review Read the paper's mass and try again.

nodes.title: Record the mass
nodes.description: Record the dry filter paper's mass in your notebook.

feedback.success: Record the mass complete.
feedback.retry: Review Record the mass and try again.

nodes.title: Fold the paper
nodes.description: Lift the paper off the pan onto the bench, then fold it in half and in half again.

feedback.success: Fold the paper complete.
feedback.retry: Review Fold the paper and try again.

nodes.title: Open it into the funnel
nodes.description: Open the folded paper into a cone, three layers on one side, and seat it in the funnel.

feedback.success: Open it into the funnel complete.
feedback.retry: Review Open it into the funnel and try again.

nodes.title: Wet the paper
nodes.description: Wet the paper with a little water from the wash bottle so it seals against the glass.

feedback.success: Wet the paper complete.
feedback.retry: Review Wet the paper and try again.

nodes.title: Put the flask under the stem
nodes.description: Stand the flask under the funnel, the stem touching the inside of its neck.

feedback.success: Put the flask under the stem complete.
feedback.retry: Review Put the flask under the stem and try again.

nodes.title: Pour the mixture through
nodes.description: Hold the stirring rod to the beaker's lip and pour down it: the clear liquid first, then the solid, a little at a time so the liquid stays about 1 cm below the paper's rim. Let the funnel drain between pours.

validation.label: Pour the mixture through was completed.

feedback.success: Pour the mixture through complete.
feedback.retry: Review Pour the mixture through and try again.

nodes.title: Rinse the beaker and rod
nodes.description: Rinse the beaker into the funnel with three small squirts, washing the stirring rod down over it too, so the last of the solid comes across.

validation.label: Rinse the beaker and rod was completed.

feedback.success: Rinse the beaker and rod complete.
feedback.retry: Review Rinse the beaker and rod and try again.

nodes.title: Wash the solid
nodes.description: Wash the solid on the paper with three small squirts of water.

feedback.success: Wash the solid complete.
feedback.retry: Review Wash the solid and try again.
